headline: 3 Brand Drop Pilot SOWs drafted for Vanta, Retool, Linear; $4,800 per pilot with NPS-based conversion to $24K annual.
highlights: SOW template: lightweight 1-2 page statement of work covering scope, pricing ($4,800), deliverables, success metrics (NPS ≥7), and conversion terms ($24K annual)
30-day pilot scope: domain-in autonomous store (Day 2), 50-unit mockup approval (Day 5), fulfillment & shipping (Day 24), NPS survey (Day 30), annual conversion decision (Day 60)
Success metrics: (1) Mockup approval ≤5 days, (2) On-time delivery, (3) NPS ≥7 → Triggers automatic invitation to $24K annual Growth Contract

Termination: Either party can decline annual conversion at Day 60 with no penalty; post-approval termination allowed with prorated refunds
Legal framework: Delaware governing law, AAA arbitration, IP ownership clarity (customer retains brand assets; Branded Fit retains platform IP), liability cap at $4,800
3 customized SOWs created: Vanta, Retool, Linear (prospect-specific with company names and signature blocks)
Outreach plan: 5-day execution window (Jun 8-14); email + PDF delivery, 15-min signing calls, payment collection by Day 5
Negotiation framework provided: Common objections (mockup deadline extension, legal review, price negotiation, payment terms) with response templates
Supporting docs: Email template, signing call agenda, fallback prospect list (Notion, Figma, Ramp), unit economics validation showing 54% pilot margin + 60% conversion rate target
